recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No source follow-up is needed for FHIR-7047 unless a future Patient Care decision revisits the boundary between these resources.
issue_request: FHIR-7047 was Published/Persuasive for the Patient Care work group and requested explanation of the relationship between AllergyIntolerance and RiskAssessment. The adopted resolution was to update both resources to say AllergyIntolerance describes a specific risk, propensity to reaction to a substance, while RiskAssessment describes general risks to a subject that are not generally based on a reaction.
initial_application: Historical source commits show the request was applied: a30496dcda added the relationship subsection to source/allergyintolerance/allergyintolerance-introduction.xml, and 3ea42ecce8 added the matching subsection to source/riskassessment/riskassessment-introduction.xml. Later source refactors preserved the relationship text.
additional_context: Both AllergyIntolerance and RiskAssessment are active resources in source/fhir.ini, so the inspected introduction pages are in current build scope. Jira neighborhood searches found only FHIR-7047 for this relationship wording, and Zulip/Confluence searches found no relevant community evidence or later decision changing the conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current AllergyIntolerance introduction states that AllergyIntolerance describes a specific type of risk, propensity to reaction to a substance/product, while RiskAssessment describes general risks to a subject. The current RiskAssessment introduction carries the parallel wording.
